content: {"praised":["Cast, sets, camerawork, and musical direction were excellent.","The music was well sung and well played.","The production was affecting and fun to watch.","The 1950s Paris setting was praised for freshness.","The overall production was described as superb and rapturous."],"criticized":["The youthful cast was overplayed and detracted from the music.","Tenor David Hobson’s thin voice was unsuitable for Puccini’s style.","Baz Luhrmann’s staging, especially the third act, was disappointing.","Heavy miking and lip‑synching obscured the singers’ true voices.","The English translation was sparse and took liberties with the text."]}
